'''Jujuin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], working in the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
Jujuin worked in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. While not a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] herself, she came to work there after the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] relocated to Tython during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She worked in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] where she sold [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]] tokens and helped serve the Jedi food and drinks.<ref name="TOR" />
